jean-luc-nancy.oneLineEn: Community and deconstructive ontology; after Derrida.

jeong-yakyong.oneLineEn: Summative Korean silhak figure who reread the classics and developed statecraft political thought.

jia-yi.oneLineEn: Early Western Han political essayist known for institutional reform and reflection on Qin's fall.

jinul.oneLineEn: Key Korean Seon figure reorganizing Buddhism via sudden enlightenment/gradual cultivation and Jogye.

jjc-smart.oneLineEn: Mind-brain identity theory and utilitarianism; fills Australian analytic philosophy.

jl-austin.oneLineEn: Source of speech-act theory; the turn from meaning to action in philosophy of language.

john-mcdowell.oneLineEn: Mind and world, virtue ethics, and conceptual experience; analytic-Hegelian interface.

jose-enrique-rodo.oneLineEn: Uruguayan thinker whose Ariel shaped Latin American spiritual identity via aesthetic-ethical education.

jose-marti.oneLineEn: Cuban independence thinker; Our America answered empire with American subjectivity.

jose-ortega-y-gasset.oneLineEn: Ratiovitalism, perspectivism, and mass-society critique; fills modern Spanish philosophy.

jose-vasconcelos.oneLineEn: Mexican thinker-educator; Cosmic Race rewrote American identity via mestizo cosmology.

joseph-albo.oneLineEn: Author of Book of Principles; reorganized Jewish doctrinal principles and faith classification.

joseph-soloveitchik.oneLineEn: Modern Orthodox thought via Halakhic man, creative personality, and loneliness of faith.

josiah-royce.oneLineEn: American absolute idealism and philosophy of community; contemporary rival of pragmatism.

judah-halevi.oneLineEn: Author of the Kuzari; dialogical defense of Jewish revelation and historical community.

judith-jarvis-thomson.oneLineEn: Rights, bioethics, and moral puzzles; fills core applied-ethics cases.

judith-shklar.oneLineEn: Liberalism of fear and theory of political evil; fills internal critique of postwar liberalism.

kamalasila.oneLineEn: Gradualist side of the Samye debate; Bhāvanākrama is a key node of Indo-Tibetan path theory.

kanada.oneLineEn: Traditional author of the Vaiśeṣika Sūtra; identity-tier anchor of Vaiśeṣika atomism and categories.

kapila-ishvarakrishna.oneLineEn: Systematized Sāṃkhya dualism and the three guṇas in the Sāṃkhya Kārikā.
